LEGISLATIVE HISTORY
 1. 6 Edw. VII, c. 41 — Marine Insurance Act, 1906
        Commencement                    :       1 January 1907
        Application                     :       12 November 1993
        Note: This Act was declared by the Application of English Law Act 1993 to
              apply or continue to apply in Singapore on 12 November 1993.
